other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via global frequency encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes frequency encodings on the concatenated train and test datasets. This leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features.

summary: The solution implements LightGBM with 5-fold cross-validation and performs basic feature engineering. However, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encodings on the combined train and test sets. Furthermore, despite extracting temporal features, it uses a randomized split rather than a time-based split, which can cause severe look-ahead bias in the evaluation.
